from.place: comparison of Proj with the projective line in the standard-chart computation

title: Chart comparison for the projective line
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $P=\operatorname{Proj}k[x_0,x_1]$ with the standard grading [def-pc-proj], and let $Q=\mathbf P^1_k$ be the glued projective line with its standard charts [def-sc-p1-standard]. A chart-compatible comparison is an isomorphism $c:P\xrightarrow{\sim}Q$ such that, for $i=0,1$, the composite $\operatorname{Spec}(k[x_0,x_1]_{(x_i)})\to P\xrightarrow{c}Q$ is the coordinate-ratio chart morphism [def-pc-linear-pair-morphism], sending the chart coordinate to $x_{1-i}/x_i$.
